x: Before the 20 Kilos there was a 5,000 metres for Youths and Juniors and a 3,000 metres for boys, and mention must be made of Sanjeev Sethi's fourth placing in the 3,000 metres.

Kevin McDermot (Mddx.) put up a PB to finish 20th in 26:05, whilst S.Sethi did a creditable 27:03 to finish 29th. Peter Morris was on the sidelines as a reserve for Surrey, unfortunately he had an "off-day" on the day of the trial; had he walked he would have gained a good placing.
